TERMS & CONDITIONS Bingo! Korean Jinjja Dance Challenge Contest Period: The Contest will be live from 17th May 2025

30th July 2025 (both dates inclusive). Entries received outside this period will not be considered. Eligibility: The Contest is open to individuals who: - Are 18 years of age or older as of the start date - Are residents of India - Employees, agents, and affiliates of the Organizer or their immediate family members are not eligible to participate. How to Participate: - Participants can submit their entries via: - The official Contest Microsite, or - The dedicated WhatsApp Bot - Each entry must: - Be a vertical video featuring the participant performing the Jinjja Dance Challenge - Use the original Jinjja audio track from the campaign - Participants may submit multiple entries during the contest period; however, only one prize can be awarded per individual. Submission Guidelines - Entries must be original and created solely by the participant. - By submitting, participants grant ITC Limited a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, display, and distribute the entry for promotional purposes. - Inappropriate, obscene, or offensive

will lead to immediate disqualification at the sole discretion of the Organizer. Winner Selection & Prizes: - Winners will be chosen based on the creativity, uniqueness, and humour of their submitted video. - All judgments will be made at the sole discretion of ITC Limited or its partner agency STVPL, and their decision will be final and binding. - From the pool of valid entries, one winner will be selected to receive a fully-sponsored trip

to Korea. - Additional shortlists, honorable mentions, or social media spotlights may be issued at the Organizer’s discretion. Announcement and Fulfilment: - Winners will be notified via the platform (WhatsApp or email) through which they submitted their entry. - Details regarding the prize fulfillment (travel, documentation, etc.) will be communicated directly to the selected winner. Disclaimers & Disqualifications: - ITC reserves the right to disqualify any participant found using unfair means or submitting fraudulent/incomplete entries. - Entries that infringe upon third-party rights or violate platform community guidelines will be removed and disqualified. - The Organizer reserves the right to cancel, modify, or terminate the Contest without notice, due to unforeseen circumstances. Platform Independence

This Contest is in no way sponsored, endorsed, administered by, or associated with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, or any third-party platform. Data Use: - Personal data collected during participation will be used solely for administration of the contest and for contacting winners. - By entering, participants consent to ITC’s use of submitted content and personal information as described above.
